script_package.title: Pipe Wars: Roadman Rumble for the Last Puff
script_package.description: Two roadmen, Character A (yellow sponge) and Character B (pink starfish), clash over a single tobacco pipe. Who will win this brainrot battle?
script_package.call_to_action: Tap to see who gets the pipe!
script_package.spoken_script:
Character A: "Yo, bruv, that pipe's mine, on my life! I saw it first, fam."
Character B: "Nah, you're moving mad! I got this in my hand, innit? Finders keepers, you washed-up opp."
Character A: "Washed? You wanna go, yeah? I'll buss your head, fam, don't test me."
Character B: "Try it, then! I'll finesse you so quick, you won't know what hit you, you little vexed sponge!"
Character A: "Vexed? I'm about to get real vexed, bruv. Give me the pipe, or we're gonna have a problem."
Character B: "Problem? You ARE the problem! This pipe is staying right here, with me. You ain't getting a puff."
Character A: "You think this is a game? I'm fiending, fam! I need that hit, right now!"
Character B: "Fiending? Look at you, shaking! You're proper weak, bruv. Get your own pipe, this one's a no-go."

His right hand is slightly outstretched, fingers twitching, as if reaching for something just out of frame. The background is a blurry, dimly lit urban alleyway with faint graffiti. Character A's mouth is slightly open, mid-sentence.
